title: Inquest scheduled for man who died while in RCMP custody
article: The B.C. Coroners Service will be holding an inquest into the death of a man who died after being taken into custody by Penticton RCMP.
Gordon Brent Amyotte, 39, was arrested May 28, 2010 for allegedly causing a disturbance in a parking lot on Martin Street.
Amyotte was being walked to the police cruiser when he suddenly collapsed.
He was rushed to hospital but died an hour later.
An inquest has been scheduled for January 16 - 20, 2012 at Supreme Court at 100 Main Street in Penticton.
Presiding coroner Mark Coleman and a jury will hear evidence from subpoenaed witnesses to determine the facts surrounding Amyotte's death.
The jury will also have the opportunity to make recommendations to prevent deaths under similar circumstances from happening in the future.
